name: Composition via Convolution (Power Form)
definition: Transforms a trivariate polynomial of max degree 3*d* into a univariate polynomial using convolution operators to reduce computation and register usage compared to naive substitution.
summary: Composition via Convolution (Power Form) evaluates trivariate polynomials along rays using convolution to minimize register usage and operation counts, prioritizing GPU performance over the numerical stability of Bernstein forms.
